name: Ecosystem Enhancement Program
summary: Large grants for landscape-scale, on-the-ground restoration of grassland, wetland, riparian and aquatic habitat in the Columbia Basin of British Columbia, through an annual expression of interest then full application.

geography.label: Columbia Basin Trust region, British Columbia

amount.note: Up to 75% of total project costs, up to five years

reporting: Projects must carry out effectiveness monitoring and maintenance to show their goals are met.

calls.label: 2026/27 intake (expression of interest, then full application)

status.quote: The EOI deadline is May 22, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. PT / 3:00 p.m. MT.

deadline.quote: The EOI deadline is May 22, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. PT / 3:00 p.m. MT.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include registered non-profits, First Nations and local governments in the Columbia Basin Trust region (ourtrust.org/map).

geography.quote: Eligible applicants include registered non-profits, First Nations and local governments in the Columbia Basin Trust region (ourtrust.org/map).

access.quote: Ecosystem Enhancement Program is a two-stage application process. First, an online Expression of Interest (EOI) must be submitted.

window.quote: Then, the Trust will request the applicant to submit a full application, due on or before October 22, 2026.

amount.quote: Up to 75% per cent of total project costs can be requested from the Trust. The maximum amount of Trust funding for any one project is $750,000 with a maximum duration of five years for multi-year projects.

co_finance_required.quote: The application must clearly demonstrate that at least 25% percent of total project costs will be received from sources other than the Trust.

reporting.quote: It is a requirement for projects to perform effectiveness monitoring and maintenance to ensure stated goals and objectives are achieved.
